description: Source code for jboot_config_read, a C program that reads and processes configuration data from firmware images, including parsing headers, verifying checksums, and extracting specific data such as MAC addresses and calibration data.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that parses command-line arguments, reads input file, finds headers, and optionally prints data or writes EEPROM data.

methods.name: print_data_header
methods.description: Prints the details of a data header, including id, type, unknown, length, and data bytes.

methods.name: print_mac
methods.description: Extracts and prints MAC address data from the data headers.

methods.name: write_eeprom
methods.description: Writes EEPROM calibration data to a specified output file.

methods.name: read_file
methods.description: Reads the entire contents of a specified file into memory buffer.

methods.name: write_file
methods.description: Writes data to a specified output file.

methods.name: find_header
methods.description: Searches the buffer for specific headers, verifies checksums, and collects data headers.

methods.name: jboot_checksum
methods.description: Calculates a checksum over data, used for verifying headers.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the command-line tool.
